Used. Light scuff on housing edge.

Untested, not described as working.

Removed from a 2017 Toyota Land Cruiser (donor vehicle, not a fitment guarantee). Please match the part number before buying.

O/S (offside, right) (guidance, verify).

This mirror came from a left-hand drive vehicle. UK cars are right-hand drive. Mirror glass and angle can differ. The buyer must verify against the part number (guidance, verify).

Fragile, glass. Pack securely. Shipping guidance, verify: 2 to 15 kg.

Included: mirror glass, housing, cover
